backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor defining all core data types (Transaction, Product, Invoice, GST, etc.) and composing storage, authorization, Stripe, and HTTP outcall mixins for a business accounting and inventory management system.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping implemented feature IDs (PayrollTaxCalculator component, region-specific tax logic, results breakdown display) to their source files, components, and test IDs with confidence ratings.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON catalog of short summaries for every frontend source file, describing the purpose and key functionality of each component, hook, page, and utility in the React application.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS entry file defining CSS custom property design tokens for light and dark themes, covering background, foreground, card, chart, and sidebar color variables.
frontend/index.html: Minimal HTML shell for the React SPA, setting the page title to 'Business Accounting and Inventory Management System' and mounting the app at the #root div.
frontend/playwright-visual.config.ts: Playwright configuration for visual regression tests, running serially on Chromium at 1920×1080 with HTML/JSON reporters and a local dev server on port 3000.
frontend/playwright.config.ts: Playwright configuration for functional tests, running in parallel on Chromium with HTML/JSON/JUnit reporters, retry logic for CI, and a local dev server on port 3000.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component that wires together ThemeProvider, QueryClientProvider, I18nProvider, and authentication state to render LoginPage, ProfileSetup, or the main Dashboard with Header and Footer.
frontend/src/components/finance-tools/Fi: A tabbed calculator component that computes liquidity, profitability, leverage, and efficiency financial ratios from user-entered inputs and displays the results in tables.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Footer component displaying the current year copyright and a caffeine.ai attribution link with UTM tracking based on the current hostname.
frontend/src/components/fund-flow/FundFl: Renders a fund flow visualization with summary cards for total sources, applications, and net flow, plus bar and line charts showing sources vs. applications comparison and historical trends using Recharts.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Sticky application header showing the BizAccounts Pro logo, authenticated user avatar and name, principal badge, dark/light theme toggle, and a logout button.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetup.tsx: A form component for new users to set up their profile by entering name, email, and optional business name, using the `useSaveCallerUserProfile` mutation and displaying toast notifications on success or error.
frontend/src/components/ProfitAndLossGen: A component that lists existing P&L statements and provides a dialog form to generate new ones by selecting a trading account and entering depreciation, income, and expense categories with progress simulation.
frontend/src/components/tabs/AccountingT: Displays journal entries with filtering and totals, tax configuration types, tax summary reports, and accounting settings including cash/accrual basis toggle, all using mock data.
frontend/src/components/tabs/AdvancedAna: Shows an advanced analytics dashboard with configurable time period and chart type selectors, computing revenue trends and period-over-period comparisons from transaction and invoice data.
frontend/src/components/tabs/AITaxResear: Provides a searchable, filterable reference UI for Indian tax provisions across Income Tax, GST, and Companies Act, displaying static provision data with category tabs.
frontend/src/components/tabs/AnalyticAcc: Manages analytic/cost accounting with CRUD for cost accounts and analytic plans, budget vs. actual tracking, and bulk operations on analytic line items using local state.
frontend/src/components/tabs/AssetsTab.t: React tab component for managing fixed assets and deferred items, supporting depreciation schedule calculation (SLM/WDV methods), asset CRUD, journal entry selection, and deferred revenue/expense recognition.
React tab component for banking operations that handles CSV bank statement import, auto-matching against internal transactions, and cash session management (open/close sessions with in/out transactions).
frontend/src/components/tabs/BankReconci: React tab component for bank reconciliation that displays mock bank statement and internal transaction data, shows match/unmatch status with summary cards, and supports manual statement entry and file upload.
frontend/src/components/tabs/CAConsultat: React tab component for CA (Chartered Accountant) consultations that provides a messaging interface, document upload, and editable CA contact info and fees, backed by ICP canister query/mutation hooks.
frontend/src/components/tabs/CAProfileMa: React tab component for managing Chartered Accountant profiles, supporting create, read, update, delete, and search operations via backend query hooks with a form dialog UI.
frontend/src/components/tabs/CashFlowRep: Displays a cash flow report tab with inflow, outflow, and net cash flow summary cards calculated from all transactions. Supports period selection (daily/monthly/quarterly/annual) and uses i18n for labels.
frontend/src/components/tabs/CurrencyMan: Manages a list of currencies with exchange rates, allowing manual rate editing, simulated rate refresh with random variation, and a currency converter utility.
frontend/src/components/tabs/CustomerPor: Renders a customer-facing portal with tabbed views for invoices, subscriptions, and orders using mock data, supporting PDF download simulation and subscription cancellation.
frontend/src/components/tabs/Depreciatio: Provides an asset depreciation calculator supporting both Income Tax Act (WDV) and Accounting Standards (SLM) methods, with add/edit asset dialogs and list/comparison views.
Similar to DepreciationCalculatorTab but defaults to a comparison view, side-by-side contrasting WDV and SLM depreciation methods for added assets.

A tab component for managing depreciable assets, supporting add/edit operations with fields like acquisition cost, useful life, and depreciation method (SLM/WDV), and displaying assets in a table with calculated depreciation.
frontend/src/components/tabs/EnhancedCas: A cash flow analysis tab that aggregates transaction data into inflows and outflows, offering simple and comparison views with period selection (daily/monthly/quarterly/annual).
frontend/src/components/tabs/FinancialCa: A multi-calculator tab providing EMI, MPBF, CMA, and IRR calculators with input forms, result displays, amortization schedules, and charts for financial analysis.
frontend/src/components/tabs/FundFlowCal: A fund flow statement calculator tab that accepts sources and applications of funds inputs, computes net working capital changes, stores records, and supports printing.
frontend/src/components/tabs/FundFlowRep: A static placeholder tab displaying a fund flow report layout with sources of funds, application of funds, and working capital changes sections, all currently showing zero values.
frontend/src/components/tabs/GovernanceT: A comprehensive corporate governance tab managing board meetings, documents, shareholders, compliance alerts, and director surveys with full CRUD functionality. Includes sub-tabs for each governance area, voice input support, and an embedded security compliance scan tab.
frontend/src/components/tabs/GSTAutomati: A GST automation tab that shows automation status, allows toggling scheduled automation and manually triggering operations, and displays a combined log of automation runs and workflow executions.
frontend/src/components/tabs/GSTCalculat: A GST calculator tab component supporting both regular and composition tax schemes, with inputs for amount and GST rate, displaying calculated CGST, SGST, IGST, and totals. Automatically syncs the GST rate from the effective tax rate based on the selected country.
frontend/src/components/tabs/GSTDataMana: A tab for managing GST records stored on-chain, allowing users to import JSON-formatted GST data with validation, view existing records in a table, and delete records. Uses React Query hooks for CRUD operations and displays toast notifications for feedback.
frontend/src/components/tabs/GSTExportsT: A tab for generating and downloading GST data exports (e-invoice, e-way bill, GSTR-1, GSTR-3B) for various GSP providers like ClearTax and Tally. Handles export generation with validation feedback and triggers file downloads on success.
frontend/src/components/tabs/GSTPurchase: A tab for creating and managing GST purchase invoices, supporting multi-item entry with automatic CGST/SGST/IGST calculation based on inter/intra-state vendor detection. Includes a dialog form for invoice creation with vendor details, line items, and payment mode.
frontend/src/components/tabs/HeadWiseInc: Displays a category-wise income analysis dashboard by filtering sale/income transactions and computing per-category totals with percentage progress bars. Includes an export button and a summary card showing total income.
frontend/src/components/tabs/ImportExpor: Provides a UI for importing CSV files (with column mapping and row validation) and exporting mock data for various entity types (invoices, transactions, contacts, etc.) in CSV or Excel format.
frontend/src/components/tabs/IncomeTaxDa: A comprehensive Indian income tax dashboard that accepts five-head income and deduction inputs, calculates tax under both old and new regimes (FY 2024-25) with surcharge, cess, and Section 87A rebate, and displays a dual-regime comparison with a recommendation.
frontend/src/components/tabs/IncomeTaxRe: A simpler income tax calculator tab that computes tax liability (including surcharge, cess, and rebate) for old or new regime based on gross income and deduction inputs, with tabs for calculator, regime comparison, and deductions tracker.
frontend/src/components/tabs/InventoryTa: Manages product inventory by listing products with stock status badges and allowing users to add new products or update stock levels via dialogs, backed by React Query hooks for CRUD operations.
frontend/src/components/tabs/InvoicesTab: Renders the Invoices tab with a full invoice creation dialog (line items, GST scheme selection, tax calculation) and a table listing all invoices with status update controls. Supports Indian GST context with multiple scheme options including Export, SEZ, Composition, and Deemed Export.
frontend/src/components/tabs/JournalLedg: Displays a Journal & Ledger tab with three sub-views: a unified chronological timeline merging journal entries and transactions, a journal entries table, and a trial balance computed from ledger balances.
frontend/src/components/tabs/OverviewTab: Renders the dashboard overview tab showing key business metric cards (sales, expenses, profit, stock value), low-stock and overdue-invoice alerts, and outstanding receivables summary.
frontend/src/components/tabs/PaymentsTab: Provides a Payments tab with four sub-sections: payment gateway configuration (Stripe, PayPal, Adyen), batch payment reconciliation, SEPA transfer scheduling, and check printing using mock data.
Implements a Payroll Management tab for adding employees (with voice input support), processing monthly payroll, generating pay slips and Form 16, and exporting statutory returns.
frontend/src/components/tabs/PayrollTaxC: A multi-region payroll tax calculator component supporting Australia, India, USA, UK, and custom bracket configurations. It computes progressive income tax, deductions, and net pay based on user-provided salary and frequency inputs.
A top-level reports dashboard that organizes financial reporting features into tabbed sections including financial statements, depreciation, income tax, cash flow, GST calculator, and AI tax research. It composes multiple sub-tab components and allows toggling between Schedule III and tabular statement formats.
frontend/src/components/tabs/ScheduleIII: Renders Indian Companies Act Schedule III-compliant Balance Sheet and Profit & Loss statements by aggregating data from transactions, products, depreciation assets, and stored financial statements. Supports printing and downloading the formatted reports.
frontend/src/components/tabs/SecurityCom: A comprehensive security and compliance dashboard UI that models assets, vulnerabilities, configuration issues, compliance frameworks (NIST, GDPR, etc.), policy audits, malware detections, and security alerts. It provides scanning controls, gap analysis, and reporting features.
frontend/src/components/tabs/SettingsTab: An application settings page with tabs for tax configuration, notification toggles, invoice branding (logo, QR code, website URL), and translation provider settings. It persists changes via custom hooks and displays toast feedback on save.
frontend/src/components/tabs/TaxRateMana: A tab for managing tax rates (GST, VAT, IncomeTax, Custom) with search, filtering by type and country, grouped display by country, and create/edit/delete functionality via a form dialog.
frontend/src/components/tabs/TDSTCSManag: A React tab component for managing TDS and TCS transactions locally, supporting CRUD operations for Income Tax Act sections with form dialogs, status tracking, and localStorage persistence.
frontend/src/components/tabs/TDSTCSModul: An enhanced TDS/TCS management tab that uses backend persistence hooks and supports linking transactions to invoices or other transactions, with filtering and CRUD operations.
frontend/src/components/tabs/Transaction: A tab for viewing, adding, and editing financial transactions, with support for voice input, journal entry creation, and i18n, backed by React Query hooks.
frontend/src/components/tabs/WorkflowsTa: A tab for listing, creating, editing, deleting, and running automation workflows, with support for predefined workflow protection and run history display.
frontend/src/components/TaxRateFormDialo: A dialog form for creating or editing a tax rate, supporting fields for country, tax type, rate name, percentage, and default flag, with validation and add/update mutations.
frontend/src/components/TradingAccountGe: A component that displays existing trading accounts and provides a dialog to generate a new trading account by entering opening/closing stock and direct expenses, calculating purchases and sales from transactions.
frontend/src/components/VoiceInput.tsx: A button component that uses the Web Speech API to capture voice input and return the transcript via a callback, with visual feedback for listening state and error handling.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: A custom hook that creates and caches an authenticated or anonymous ICP backend actor using React Query, invalidating dependent queries whenever the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useAppLanguagePrefere: Hook that manages the app's language preference by reading/writing to localStorage, detecting browser language as a fallback, and dispatching a custom event when the language changes.
Hook that automatically rotates through five predefined gradient theme variants every 30 seconds, persisting the current variant to localStorage with options to manually set or disable rotation.
frontend/src/hooks/useBusinessGSTSetting: Hook that loads and saves business GST settings (state code and GSTIN) to localStorage, defaulting to Maharashtra (state code 27).
frontend/src/hooks/useFundFlowRecords.ts: Hook that manages fund flow financial records in localStorage, providing add, retrieve-latest, and retrieve-history operations with Date serialization/deserialization.
frontend/src/hooks/useGSTAutomation.ts: Hook collection using React Query that manages GST automation status and logs in localStorage, supporting querying status/logs and triggering simulated automation runs with provider credential validation.
frontend/src/hooks/useGSTExports.ts: Hook that provides mutations to generate GST export payloads mapped to provider-specific formats (ClearTax, Masters India, IRIS, Tally) and download them as JSON files.
frontend/src/hooks/useGSTProviderSetting: Hook collection using React Query that manages GST provider credentials (ClearTax, Masters India, IRIS, Tally) stored in localStorage per user principal, with CRUD operations and legacy ClearTax-specific exports.
frontend/src/hooks/useGSTUniversalData.t: Hook collection using React Query that provides full CRUD operations for unified GST records stored in localStorage, scoped per user principal.
frontend/src/hooks/useGSTWorkflows.ts: Provides React Query hooks for CRUD operations on GST workflow definitions and run logs, persisting data in localStorage per user principal and initializing with predefined workflows.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Implements an Internet Identity authentication context and provider using DFINITY's AuthClient, exposing login/logout functions and identity state with status tracking.
frontend/src/hooks/useInvoiceBranding.ts: Hook that loads and saves invoice branding settings (website URL, payment QR) to localStorage using safeLocalStorage.
Provides React Query hooks to get and set legacy tax settings (GSTIN, GST type, state code) stored in localStorage.
frontend/src/hooks/usePurchaseInvoices.t: Hook for managing GST purchase invoices with create, update, and delete operations, persisting data in localStorage keyed by the authenticated user's principal.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for transactions, products, journal entries, ledger accounts, and other entities, using localStorage as a fallback since corresponding backend canister methods are not yet implemented.
frontend/src/hooks/useSelectedTaxCountry: Simple hook that persists and retrieves the selected tax country code (defaulting to 'IN') in localStorage.
Custom React hook that manages tax rates using React Query and localStorage, with predefined seed data for 15+ countries covering GST, VAT, and income tax slabs.
frontend/src/hooks/useTaxSettings.ts: Custom React hooks for getting and saving per-country tax settings using localStorage as a backend substitute, with React Query for caching and invalidation.
Provides React Query hooks for CRUD operations on TDS and TCS records, storing them in localStorage per authenticated user principal with BigInt serialization support.
frontend/src/hooks/useTranslatedText.ts: Custom React hooks for translating dynamic text strings using machine translation with in-memory caching, and optionally persisting translations to the backend via an actor.

frontend/src/lib/gst/import/parseAndVali: Parses a JSON string representing a GST record and validates required fields based on record type (invoice, e-invoice, e-way bill, GSTR-1, GSTR-3B), returning errors and warnings.
frontend/src/lib/gst/workflows/predefine: Defines a set of predefined GST workflow configurations including e-invoice generation, e-way bill, GSTR-1/3B filing preparation, reconciliation, and a complete end-to-end workflow.
frontend/src/lib/ledger.ts: Provides functions to compute ledger account balances from journal entries and calculate a trial balance with debit/credit totals and balance verification.
frontend/src/lib/serialization.ts: Provides utilities for safely serializing/deserializing BigInt values to/from JSON, converting Motoko time types to JavaScript Dates, and safe localStorage operations with BigInt support.
frontend/src/lib/taxRates.ts: Defines a list of country tax rates with helper functions to look up default tax rates by country code or name.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that renders the React app wrapped in QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/src/pages/Dashboard.tsx: Main dashboard page that organizes all feature tabs (invoices, payments, GST, payroll, analytics, etc.) into grouped navigation using a Tabs component.
frontend/src/pages/LoginPage.tsx: Login page displaying BizAccounts Pro branding, feature highlights, and an Internet Identity login button.
frontend/src/types/gst-purchase.ts: TypeScript interfaces for GST purchase invoice line items and full purchase invoice records including tax breakdowns and ITC eligibility.
frontend/src/types/gst-universal.ts: Provider-agnostic TypeScript interfaces for GST automation including e-invoices, e-way bills, GSTR filings, reconciliation results, and provider metadata.
frontend/src/types/gst-workflows.ts: TypeScript interfaces defining GST workflow definitions, steps, run logs, and step-level execution logs for automated GST operations.
frontend/src/types/index.ts: Central types barrel file exporting all domain enums and interfaces including transactions, invoices, products, GST, payroll, and accounting entities.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for extracting URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routing, with sessionStorage persistence helpers to maintain values like admin tokens across navigation.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration with dark mode, custom OKLCH-based color tokens, extended border radius, box shadows, and plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
frontend/tests/functional/invoice.spec.t: Playwright functional tests for invoice management, verifying sequential invoice number generation (INV-YYYY-NNN format), uniqueness across multiple invoices, and the invoice creation workflow.
frontend/tests/functional/trading-accoun: Playwright functional tests for trading account generation, covering statement creation with stock and expense inputs, calculation validation, and PDF export.
frontend/tests/functional/transaction-jo: Playwright functional tests covering journal entry synchronization when transactions are edited, and multilingual UI translation switching between English and Hindi.
Vitest unit tests using AJV to validate JSON schemas for invoice and dashboard metrics API responses, including GSTIN length validation.
frontend/tests/visual/reports.spec.ts: Playwright visual regression tests that capture and compare screenshots of the trading account, profit & loss, balance sheet report sections, and the dashboard overview.
frontend/vitest.config.json: Vitest configuration targeting schema test files in a Node environment with v8 coverage reporting and a path alias for `@` pointing to `/src`.
project_state.json: Tracks project state (version 3) for a standalone Payroll Tax Calculator supporting Australia, India, USA, UK, and Custom/Generic regions with detailed architectural notes, existing features, and requirements.
